# Bike-share glossary

The words the rider app and the help center use.

| Release | Date       |
| ------- | ---------- |
| 1       | 2026-03-01 |

```md
| Use  | Avoid |
| ---- | ----- |
| Fake | wrong |
```

| Use                            | Avoid                                              | Meaning                                       | Notes                                                       | Links                                    |
| :----------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------- |
| Dock                           | rack (racks are unpowered), bay                    | A powered stand where one bike is locked.     | A station is a group of [docks](https://example.com/docks). |                                          |
| Day Pass (DP), Week Pass (WP)  | ticket                                             | Unlimited 30-minute rides for a set period.   |                                                             | https://example.com/passes               |
| `eBike`                        | e-bike, electric bike                              | A bike with a motor that helps you pedal.     | Shown as `eBike \| Classic` in the bike picker.             |                                          |
| SOS                            |                                                    | The emergency button on the handlebar.        | —                                                           |                                          |
| kiosk                          | terminal                                           | The screen at a station where you buy passes. | Always lowercase, even at the start of a sentence.          |                                          |
| **Station**                    | hub, depot (riders confuse it, with the warehouse) | A group of docks on one street corner.        |                                                             | [Stations](https://example.com/stations) |
| Rider (anyone with an account) | user                                               | A person who can unlock bikes.                |                                                             |                                          |

Rows after the table are not read.
